lesson.title: 函数的积与商
lesson.description: 由原图、代数、应用模型与阻尼振荡学习函数的积与商；完整保留原式及定义域限制。

en.title: Products and Quotients of Functions
en.description: Study products and quotients through original graphs, algebra, models, and damped oscillation; retain original formulas and domain restrictions.

concepts.title: 函数的积与共同定义域
concepts.summary: $(f\cdot g)(x)=f(x)g(x)$；先取两个原函数定义域的交集。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 在相同的 $x$ 处相乘纵坐标；代数式相乘并展开或因式分解。保留原根式及分母限制，再由具体图像或代数求值域。 教材旁注：乘法也可用居中点表示，例如 $2\times5=2\cdot5$。

pitfalls: 积的定义域不能由化简后的式子单独决定。

en.title: Products and common domains
en.summary: $(f\cdot g)(x)=f(x)g(x)$; first intersect the domains of both original functions.

method.title: Method
method.body: Multiply the y-values at the same x. Multiply the formulas, then expand or factor. Retain original radical and denominator restrictions; find the range from the resulting function. Textbook sidebar: multiplication can use a centred dot, for example $2\times5=2\cdot5$.

pitfalls: Do not infer the product domain from its simplified formula alone.

concepts.title: 函数的商、零点与空洞
concepts.summary: $(f/g)(x)=f(x)/g(x)$；定义域是共同定义域再排除 $g(x)=0$ 的点。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先找原分母函数的零点，再因式分解约分。约掉的零点仍排除，常表现为空洞；未约掉的零因子可给出竖直渐近线。用原限制求值域。

pitfalls: 分子为零不一定给出截距：分母也为零时原商无定义。
交换分子和分母会改变函数及定义域。

en.title: Quotients, zeros, and holes
en.summary: $(f/g)(x)=f(x)/g(x)$; use the common domain and also exclude every zero of g.

method.title: Method
method.body: Find the original denominator zeros before cancelling. A cancelled zero remains excluded and may create a hole. A surviving zero factor can give a vertical asymptote. Use the original restrictions to determine the range.

pitfalls: A numerator zero is not an intercept if the original denominator is also zero.
Reversing numerator and denominator changes both function and domain.

concepts.title: 由原图构造运算图像
concepts.summary: 同一横坐标的函数值相乘或相除；图上必须标明函数、刻度、空洞和渐近线。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先读取若干准确点并写函数式，再画所得曲线。图像只显示窗口内部分；定义域和值域还要核查端点、无穷行为和原限制。三角函数本节使用弧度。

pitfalls: 有限窗口不能证明值域有界。

en.title: Constructing operation graphs
en.summary: At a common x, multiply or divide the original function values. Label functions, scales, holes, and asymptotes.

method.title: Method
method.body: Read exact labelled points, find formulas, and plot the result. A window shows only part of a graph; verify endpoints, unbounded behavior, and original restrictions. Trigonometric graphs here use radians.

pitfalls: A finite viewing window cannot establish a bounded range.

concepts.title: 应用模型与单位
concepts.summary: 积可表示收入或面积，商可表示每单位数量、概率或高度；先核对单位及情境范围。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 写出每个量的单位，组合模型并化简，然后把代数限制与非负时间、正长度、整数场次等取交集。若来源单位冲突，保留原题并分清字面结论与额外假设。 概率旁注：等可能结果下，概率等于有利结果数除以所有可能结果数。

pitfalls: 不能用不符合单位的数值交点冒充实际结论。

en.title: Application models and units
en.summary: Products can model revenue or area; quotients can model per-unit quantities, probability, or height. Check units and the contextual domain.

method.title: Method
method.body: Identify units, combine and simplify the models, then intersect algebraic restrictions with nonnegative time, positive lengths, or whole game numbers. If source units conflict, distinguish the literal result from an added interpretation. Probability sidebar: with equally likely outcomes, probability is favourable outcomes divided by all possible outcomes.

pitfalls: A numerical intersection of differently scaled quantities is not a physical equality.

concepts.title: 乘积、包络线与阻尼
concepts.summary: 若 $|g(x)|\le1$，则 $|f(x)g(x)|\le |f(x)|$，乘积位于 $f$ 与 $-f$ 之间。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 辨认周期因子与振幅因子；画出正负包络线。只有包络振幅随时间减小才是阻尼；包络线交叉或周期变化不等于持续衰减。 教材背景：阻尼谐振子做振幅渐小的循环运动，例如推动后自由摆动的秋千或摆锤。1851年，Jean Foucault用长摆的摆动平面与地球转动展示地球自转。

pitfalls: $\cos(2t)$ 的载波周期是 $\pi$，但乘以衰减因子后整体不再周期。

en.title: Products, envelopes, and damping
en.summary: If $|g(x)|\le1$, then $|f(x)g(x)|\le|f(x)|$, so the product lies between f and -f.

method.title: Method
method.body: Identify the periodic factor and amplitude factor and draw both envelopes. Damping requires decreasing amplitude in time; crossing or periodically varying envelopes need not decay. Textbook context: a damped harmonic oscillator cycles with decreasing amplitude, as with a swing after a push or a freely swinging pendulum. In 1851, Jean Foucault demonstrated Earth rotation with a long pendulum whose swing plane remained fixed while Earth rotated beneath it.

pitfalls: The carrier cos(2 t) has period pi, but its decaying product is not periodic.

questions.prompt: 考察给出的 $f(x)$ 和 $g(x)$ 图像。(a) 复制表格，横坐标为 $-4,-2,0,2,4,6$；由图填入 $f(x),g(x)$，末列填入乘积 $p(x)$。(b) 预测 $p(x)$ 的形状，复制原图并在同一坐标系画出 $p(x)$。(c) $p(x)$ 的 $x$ 截距与两个原函数的 $x$ 截距有何关系？

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: $f=x-2$、$g=\frac12x-1$，所以 $p=\frac12(x-2)^2$。画开口向上的抛物线，顶点 $(2,0)$，并通过表中各点。

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: 积在任一因子为零且两者都有定义时为零。本题两个因子都在 $x=2$ 为零，因此只有一个 $x$ 截距 $(2,0)$，且为二重零点。

en.prompt: Consider the graphs of the functions $f(x)$ and $g(x)$. (a) Copy the table with $x=-4,-2,0,2,4,6$ and use each graph to complete the columns for $f(x)$ and $g(x)$. In the last column enter the product $p(x)$. (b) Predict the shape of $p(x)$, then copy the graphs of f and g and sketch p on the same axes. (c) How are the x-intercepts of p related to those of f and g?

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: Read the labelled lines: for $x=-4,-2,0,2,4,6$, f-values are $-6,-4,-2,0,2,4$ and g-values are $-3,-2,-1,0,1,2$. Row-by-row multiplication gives $p=18,8,2,0,2,8$.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: The lines give $f=x-2$ and $g=\frac12x-1$, hence $p=\frac12(x-2)^2$. Draw an upward parabola with vertex $(2,0)$ through the table points.

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: The product is zero wherever either factor is zero and both are defined. Here both factors vanish at $x=2$, so there is one x-intercept $(2,0)$, a double zero.

en.label: Investigate 1

questions.label: 探究 1

questions.prompt: (a) 确定活动图中 $f(x),g(x)$ 的方程。(b) 如何由这两个式子写 $p(x)$？写方程并核对与图像相符。

en.prompt: (a) Determine the equations of f and g in the investigation graph. (b) How can you use their equations to write the equation of p? Write it and verify that it matches the graph.

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: The blue line passes through $(0,-2),(2,0)$, giving slope 1 and $f=x-2$. The red line passes through $(0,-1),(2,0)$, giving slope $\frac12$ and $g=\frac12x-1$.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: Multiply: $p=(x-2)(\frac12x-1)=\frac12x^2-2x+2=\frac12(x-2)^2$. Its vertex is $(2,0)$, its axis is $x=2$, and $p(0)=p(4)=2$, matching the sketch.

en.label: Investigate 2

questions.label: 探究 2

questions.prompt: (a) 活动中的 $f,g,p$ 的定义域和值域是什么？(b) 三个定义域的关系与函数加减时是否相同？解释。

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: 两个非水平直线的定义域和值域均为 $\mathbb{R}$。$p=\frac12(x-2)^2\ge0$，在 $x=2$ 取零且向上无界，故 $D_p=\mathbb{R}$，$R_p=[0,\infty)$。

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: 相同：积与和差一样，只允许两个原函数同时有定义的横坐标，即 $D_f\cap D_g$。本题交集为所有实数；值域无需等于原函数值域的交集。

en.prompt: (a) What are the domain and range of f, g, and p in the investigation? (b) Is the relationship between their domains the same as for addition and subtraction of functions? Explain.

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: Both nonhorizontal lines have domain and range $\mathbb{R}$. Since $p=\frac12(x-2)^2\ge0$, equals 0 at 2, and is unbounded above, $D_p=\mathbb{R}$ and $R_p=[0,\infty)$.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: Yes. Like a sum or difference, a product requires both original functions to be defined, so its domain is $D_f\cap D_g=\mathbb{R}$. The range need not be the intersection of the original ranges.

en.label: Investigate 3

questions.label: 探究 3

questions.prompt: (a) 在活动1的表格增加 $q(x)$ 一列，填入 $f(x)$ 除以 $g(x)$ 的商。(b) 预测形状，并在原函数同一坐标系画商。(c) 原函数的 $x$ 截距与 $q(x)$ 的值有何关系？

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: 因为 $f=2g$，商图是水平直线 $y=2$，但 $x=2$ 时分母为零，因此在 $(2,2)$ 画空心点。

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: $g$ 的零点一定排除。$f$ 的零点仅在 $g\ne0$ 时使商为零；本题两线的零点相同，故 $q$ 没有 $x$ 截距，在 $x=2$ 无定义。

en.prompt: (a) Add a fifth column headed q(x) to the table from step 1 and fill it with the quotient of f(x) and g(x). (b) Predict its shape, then copy f and g and sketch q on the same axes. (c) How are the x-intercepts of f and g related to the values of q?

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: Because $f=2g$, the quotient is the horizontal line $y=2$ with an open point at $(2,2)$, where the denominator is zero.

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: A zero of g is excluded. A zero of f makes q zero only if g is nonzero. Here their zeros coincide, so q has no x-intercept and is undefined at 2.

en.label: Investigate 4

questions.label: 探究 4

questions.prompt: (a) 如何使用活动2(a)的方程写商 $q(x)$？写出并核对图像。(b) 给出 $q$ 的定义域和值域；定义域关系与加减时是否相同？解释。

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $q=(x-2)/(\frac12x-1)=2(x-2)/(x-2)=2$，必须保留 $x\ne2$。这给出带一个空洞的水平线。

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: $D_q=\mathbb{R}\setminus\{2\}$，$R_q=\{2\}$；删去一个横坐标并未删去常数值2，因为其他横坐标也给2。定义域关系不完全相同：除共同定义域外还要排除分母函数的零点。

en.prompt: (a) How can you use the equations from step 2(a) to write q(x)? Write it and verify the graph. (b) State its domain and range. Is the relationship between the domains of f, g, and q the same as for addition and subtraction? Explain.

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $q=(x-2)/(\frac12x-1)=2(x-2)/(x-2)=2$, retaining $x\ne2$. This is a horizontal line with one hole.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: $D_q=\mathbb{R}\setminus\{2\}$ and $R_q=\{2\}$. Removing one x does not remove the constant output 2. Unlike a sum or difference, a quotient also excludes zeros of the denominator function.

en.label: Investigate 5

questions.label: 探究 5

questions.prompt: 考察 $f(x)=x$ 与 $g(x)=-2x+2$ 的给定图像。(a) 解释如何写积的方程并画图。(b) 解释如何写商的方程并画图。(c) 求积或商的定义域必须考虑什么？

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $p=x(-2x+2)=-2x^2+2x=-2(x-\frac12)^2+\frac12$。画向下抛物线，过 $(0,0),(1,0)$，顶点 $(\frac12,\frac12)$；定义域所有实数，值域 $y\le\frac12$。

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: $q=x/(-2x+2)=-\frac12-\frac1{2(x-1)}$。画过 $(0,0)$ 的双曲线，竖直渐近线 $x=1$，水平渐近线 $y=-\frac12$。定义域 $x\ne1$，值域 $y\ne-\frac12$。

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: 两种运算先取共同定义域。商还必须排除分母 $g=0$，本题是 $x=1$；即使约分消失也不能恢复原来不允许的值。

en.prompt: Consider the graphs of $f(x)=x$ and $g(x)=-2x+2$. (a) Explain how to write the equation and produce the graph of their product. (b) Explain how to write the equation and produce the graph of their quotient. (c) What must you consider when determining a product or quotient domain?

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $p=x(-2x+2)=-2x^2+2x=-2(x-\frac12)^2+\frac12$. Draw a downward parabola through $(0,0),(1,0)$ with vertex $(\frac12,\frac12)$; domain all real numbers, range $y\le\frac12$.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: $q=x/(-2x+2)=-\frac12-\frac1{2(x-1)}$. Draw a hyperbola through $(0,0)$ with asymptotes $x=1$ and $y=-\frac12$. Its domain excludes 1 and its range excludes $-\frac12$.

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: Both operations use the common domain. The quotient also excludes zeros of denominator g, here $x=1$. Cancellation never restores an originally forbidden input.

en.label: Reflect and Respond 6

questions.label: 思考与回应 6

questions.prompt: 已知 $f(x)=(x+2)^2-5$ 与 $g(x)=3x-4$，求 $h(x)=(f\cdot g)(x)$，并说明定义域和值域。

steps.title: 定义域和值域 / Domain and range
steps.body: 两个原函数都是多项式，故共同定义域为 $\mathbb{R}$。所得三次多项式连续，$x\to\infty$ 时向上无界，$x\to-\infty$ 时向下无界，所以值域也是 $\mathbb{R}$。

en.prompt: Given $f(x)=(x+2)^2-5$ and $g(x)=3x-4$, determine $h(x)=(f\cdot g)(x)$. State the domain and range of h.

steps.title: 定义域和值域 / Domain and range
steps.body: Both original polynomials have domain $\mathbb{R}$. The resulting continuous cubic tends to opposite infinities at the two ends, so its range is also $\mathbb{R}$.

en.label: Example 1

questions.label: 例题 1

questions.prompt: 如何由原函数判断例题1的积为三次函数？

steps.title: 次数 / Degree
steps.body: $f$ 是二次且首项 $x^2$，$g$ 是一次且首项 $3x$；乘积首项 $3x^3$ 不为零，所以次数为 $2+1=3$。

en.prompt: How can you tell from the original functions that the product in Example 1 is a cubic function?

steps.title: 次数 / Degree
steps.body: f has degree 2 with leading term $x^2$, and g has degree 1 with leading term $3x$. Their nonzero leading product is $3x^3$, so the degree is $2+1=3$.

en.answer: The leading term is $3x^3$, so it is cubic.
en.label: Example 1 · Margin question

questions.label: 例题 1 · 次数旁注

questions.prompt: 已知 $f(x)=x^2$、$g(x)=\sqrt{4x-5}$，求 $h(x)=f(x)g(x)$ 并说明定义域和值域。

steps.title: 式子与定义域 / Formula and domain
steps.body: $h=x^2\sqrt{4x-5}$。根式要求 $4x-5\ge0$，所以 $x\ge\frac54$；$x^2$ 不再增加限制。

steps.title: 值域 / Range
steps.body: 在此区间两个因子非负，$h(\frac54)=0$；函数连续并向上无界，因此取到所有非负值。

en.prompt: Given $f(x)=x^2$ and $g(x)=\sqrt{4x-5}$, determine $h(x)=f(x)g(x)$. State the domain and range of h.

steps.title: 式子与定义域 / Formula and domain
steps.body: $h=x^2\sqrt{4x-5}$. The radical requires $4x-5\ge0$, hence $x\ge\frac54$; $x^2$ imposes no further restriction.

steps.title: 值域 / Range
steps.body: On this interval both factors are nonnegative, $h(\frac54)=0$, and the continuous product is unbounded above. Its range is all nonnegative values.

en.label: Your Turn 1

questions.label: 轮到你 1

questions.prompt: 考察 $f(x)=x^2+x-6$ 和 $g(x)=2x+6$。(a) 求 $h(x)=(g/f)(x)$ 的方程。(b) 在同一坐标系画 $f,g,h$。(c) 说明 $h$ 的定义域和值域。

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: 定义域 $\mathbb{R}\setminus\{-3,2\}$。$2/(x-2)$ 永不为零；令其等于 $-\frac25$ 只得到已排除的 $x=-3$，故还要删去该输出。其他非零值由 $x=2+2/y$ 唯一取得。

en.prompt: Consider $f(x)=x^2+x-6$ and $g(x)=2x+6$. (a) Determine the equation of $h(x)=(g/f)(x)$. (b) Sketch f, g, and h on the same coordinate axes. (c) State the domain and range of h.

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $h=(2x+6)/(x^2+x-6)=2(x+3)/[(x+3)(x-2)]=2/(x-2)$, with both original denominator zeros $x=-3,2$ excluded.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: f passes through $(-3,0),(2,0),(0,-6)$ with vertex $(-\frac12,-\frac{25}4)$; g passes through $(-3,0),(0,6)$. The quotient passes through $(0,-1),(1,-2),(3,2),(4,1)$, has a hole at $(-3,-\frac25)$, and asymptotes $x=2,y=0$. All three are labelled in the solution graph.

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: The domain is $\mathbb{R}\setminus\{-3,2\}$. The reciprocal never equals 0; output $-\frac25$ occurs only at excluded $x=-3$. Every other nonzero y has the unique input $x=2+2/y$.

en.label: Example 2

questions.label: 例题 2

questions.prompt: 如何利用 $f(x),g(x)$ 两列的值确定 $h(x)$ 一列？

steps.title: 同一输入相除 / Divide at the same input

questions.answer: 每行算 $g/f$，原分母为零的行无定义。

en.prompt: How could you use the values in the columns for f(x) and g(x) to determine the values in the column for h(x)?

steps.title: 同一输入相除 / Divide at the same input
steps.body: Here $h=g/f$, so divide the g-entry by the f-entry in each row. At $x=-2$, $h=2/(-4)=-\frac12$. At $x=-3$, $0/0$ is undefined; at 2, $10/0$ is also undefined.

en.answer: Divide g by f in each row; rows with zero denominator are undefined.
en.label: Example 2 · Table question

questions.label: 例题 2 · 表格旁注

questions.prompt: $h$ 图像上点的纵坐标与 $f,g$ 图像点的纵坐标有何关系？

steps.title: 对应纵坐标 / Corresponding ordinates
steps.body: 取同一横坐标且 $f(x)\ne0$，$y_h=y_g/y_f$。例如 $x=3$ 时，$y_f=6,y_g=12$，所以 $y_h=2$；不能取不同横坐标的点相除。

en.prompt: How are the y-coordinates of points on h related to those on the graphs of f and g?

steps.title: 对应纵坐标 / Corresponding ordinates
steps.body: At the same x, provided $f(x)\ne0$, $y_h=y_g/y_f$. At 3, $y_f=6,y_g=12$, giving $y_h=2$. Values at different x-coordinates must not be combined.

en.label: Example 2 · Coordinates question

questions.label: 例题 2 · 纵坐标旁注

questions.prompt: 如何知道例题2有一个可去间断点和一条渐近线？

steps.title: 先分解再分类 / Factor and classify
steps.body: 原分母 $(x+3)(x-2)$ 在 $-3,2$ 为零。因子 $x+3$ 与分子约掉，化简式在 $-3$ 有有限值 $-\frac25$，所以那里是空洞；$x-2$ 未约掉，在2附近商无界，所以 $x=2$ 是竖直渐近线。

en.prompt: How do you know there is a point of discontinuity and an asymptote in Example 2?

steps.title: 先分解再分类 / Factor and classify
steps.body: The original denominator $(x+3)(x-2)$ vanishes at -3 and 2. Factor $x+3$ cancels and the reduced formula has finite value $-\frac25$ at -3, producing a hole. Factor $x-2$ remains, and the quotient is unbounded near 2, producing a vertical asymptote.

en.label: Example 2 · Discontinuity question

questions.label: 例题 2 · 间断点旁注

questions.prompt: 令 $f(x)=x+2$，$g(x)=x^2+9x+14$。(a) 求 $h(x)=(f/g)(x)$。(b) 在同一坐标系画 $f,g,h$。(c) 给出 $h$ 的定义域和值域。

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: $D=\mathbb{R}\setminus\{-7,-2\}$。商永不为零，输出 $\frac15$ 唯一对应 $x=-2$，所以 $R=\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0,\frac15\}$。

en.prompt: Let $f(x)=x+2$ and $g(x)=x^2+9x+14$. (a) Determine $h(x)=(f/g)(x)$. (b) Sketch f, g, and h on the same axes. (c) State the domain and range of h.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: f passes through $(-2,0),(0,2)$. g has roots -7 and -2 and vertex $(-\frac92,-\frac{25}4)$. h has asymptotes $x=-7,y=0$, a hole $(-2,\frac15)$, and points $(-6,1),(-8,-1),(0,\frac17)$. The solution graph shows all three.

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: $D=\mathbb{R}\setminus\{-7,-2\}$. The quotient never equals zero, and output $\frac15$ corresponds only to excluded input -2. Hence $R=\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0,\frac15\}$.

steps.body: $d(t)=p(t)q(t)=10(0.95)^t\cos(2t)$，$t\ge0$，单位厘米。它把理想摆动的位移乘以逐渐缩小的比例，表示有阻尼摆锤的实际位移。

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: 从 $d(0)=10$ 起，在包络线 $\pm10(0.95)^t$ 之间来回变化；零点为 $t=\frac\pi4+n\frac\pi2$（$n=0,1,\ldots$）。载波周期 $\pi$ 秒，但整体振幅变化，所以整体不周期。包络线趋于零，表示摆动逐渐停在平衡位置；其极值不必恰在载波波峰时刻。

(b) Graph the combined function, describe its characteristics, and explain how it models the pendulum motion.

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $d(t)=10(0.95)^t\cos(2t)$, for $t\ge0$, in centimetres. It scales the ideal oscillation by a shrinking factor and represents the displacement of a damped pendulum.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: The graph starts at $d(0)=10$ and oscillates between envelopes $\pm10(0.95)^t$. Its zeros occur at $t=\frac\pi4+n\frac\pi2$, $n=0,1,\ldots$. The carrier period is pi seconds, but the changing amplitude makes the product nonperiodic. The envelopes approach 0, modelling gradual rest; product extrema need not occur at carrier maxima.

en.answer: $d(t)=10(0.95)^t\cos(2t)$ cm, $t\ge0$; its oscillation amplitude tends to 0.

exercises.prompt: 考察 $f(x)=2x+5$ 与 $g(x)=\cos x$。(a) 在同一坐标系画 $f,g$ 并说明各自的定义域和值域。(b) 画 $y=f(x)g(x)$ 并说明合成函数的定义域和值域。

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $f$ 为斜率2、截距5的直线，$D_f=R_f=\mathbb{R}$。$g$ 为振幅1、周期 $2\pi$ 的余弦曲线，$D_g=\mathbb{R},R_g=[-1,1]$，采用弧度；解析图画在同一坐标系。

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: $y=(2x+5)\cos x$，共同定义域所有实数。它连续；在 $x=2n\pi$ 有值 $4n\pi+5\to\infty$，在 $x=(2n+1)\pi$ 有值 $-[2(2n+1)\pi+5]\to-\infty$。由连续性取遍所有实数，故值域 $\mathbb{R}$；零点包括 $x=-\frac52$ 以及 $x=\frac\pi2+n\pi$。

en.prompt: Consider $f(x)=2x+5$ and $g(x)=\cos x$. (a) Graph f and g on the same axes and state the domain and range of each. (b) Graph $y=f(x)g(x)$ and state the domain and range of the combined function.

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: f is the line of slope 2 and intercept 5, with $D_f=R_f=\mathbb{R}$. g is a cosine curve of amplitude 1 and period $2\pi$ radians, with $D_g=\mathbb{R}$, $R_g=[-1,1]$. Both are plotted together.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: $y=(2x+5)\cos x$ has domain all real numbers and is continuous. At $x=2n\pi$, its values $4n\pi+5$ tend to infinity; at $x=(2n+1)\pi$, values $-[2(2n+1)\pi+5]$ tend to negative infinity. Continuity gives range $\mathbb{R}$. Zeros include $-\frac52$ and $\frac\pi2+n\pi$.

exercises.prompt: 由所给 $f,g$，画 $y=(f/g)(x)$，说明定义域、值域和限制。(a) $f=\tan x,g=\cos x$；(b) $f=\cos x,g=0.8^x$。

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $y=\tan x/\cos x=\sin x/\cos^2x$。原 $\tan$ 及分母都要求 $\cos x\ne0$，即 $x\ne\frac\pi2+n\pi$（$n\in\mathbb{Z}$）；这些是竖直渐近线。$x=n\pi$ 时商为0。在区间 $(-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2)$ 函数连续，两端分别趋 $-\infty,+\infty$，所以值域所有实数；图的周期 $2\pi$。

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: $y=\cos x/(0.8)^x=(1.25)^x\cos x$。指数函数始终正，故没有额外排除，定义域 $\mathbb{R}$。零点 $\frac\pi2+n\pi$；随着 $x\to-\infty$，包络趋0；向右包络 $\pm1.25^x$ 变大。在 $2n\pi$ 取任意大的正值，在 $(2n+1)\pi$ 取任意小的负值，且连续，所以值域 $\mathbb{R}$；整体不周期。

en.prompt: Given f and g, graph $y=(f/g)(x)$. State the domain and range of the combined function and any restrictions. (a) $f(x)=\tan x$, $g(x)=\cos x$; (b) $f(x)=\cos x$, $g(x)=0.8^x$.

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $y=\tan x/\cos x=\sin x/\cos^2x$. Both the original tangent and the denominator require $\cos x\ne0$, hence $x\ne\frac\pi2+n\pi$, $n\in\mathbb{Z}$; these are vertical asymptotes. Zeros are $x=n\pi$. On $(-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2)$ it is continuous with limits negative and positive infinity, so the range is R. The graph has period $2\pi$.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: $y=\cos x/(0.8)^x=(1.25)^x\cos x$. The exponential denominator is always positive, so the domain is R without exclusions. Zeros are $\frac\pi2+n\pi$. The envelope tends to 0 to the left and grows as $\pm1.25^x$ to the right. Values at $2n\pi$ are unbounded positive and those at $(2n+1)\pi$ unbounded negative. Continuity gives range R; the product is not periodic.

exercises.prompt: 令 $f(x)=\sin x,g(x)=\cos x$。(a) 用函数的商写与 $\tan x$ 相等的式子。(b) 用函数的积写与 $1-\cos^2x$ 相等的式子。(c) 用图形技术验证(a),(b)。

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: 由正切恒等式，$(f/g)(x)=\sin x/\cos x=\tan x$；两边均要求 $x\ne\frac\pi2+n\pi$，$n\in\mathbb{Z}$。

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$ 给出 $1-\cos^2x=\sin^2x$，所以 $(f\cdot f)(x)=\sin x\sin x$；定义域所有实数。

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: 在弧度模式分别叠画 $\sin x/\cos x$ 与 $\tan x$，它们在共同定义域重合，且有相同竖直渐近线；再叠画 $(\sin x)^2$ 与 $1-(\cos x)^2$，完全重合在0到1之间。解析图按这些恒等式绘制；例如 $x=\pi/4$ 时两组值分别为1与 $1/2$。

exercises.answer: (a) $(f/g)(x)$，$\cos x\ne0$；(b) $(f\cdot f)(x)$；(c) 两组图像分别重合。

en.prompt: Let $f(x)=\sin x$ and $g(x)=\cos x$. (a) Write an expression as a quotient of functions equivalent to $\tan x$. (b) Write an expression as a product of functions equivalent to $1-\cos^2x$. (c) Use graphing technology to verify your answers to (a) and (b).

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: By the tangent identity, $(f/g)(x)=\sin x/\cos x=\tan x$. Both formulas require $x\ne\frac\pi2+n\pi$, $n\in\mathbb{Z}$.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: The identity $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$ gives $1-\cos^2x=\sin^2x$, so use $(f\cdot f)(x)=\sin x\sin x$, on all real numbers.

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: In radians, overlay $\sin x/\cos x$ and $\tan x$: they coincide on their common domain and share vertical asymptotes. Overlay $(\sin x)^2$ and $1-(\cos x)^2$: they coincide between 0 and 1. The solution plots these identities; at $x=\pi/4$ the two pairs have values 1 and $1/2$.

en.answer: (a) $(f/g)(x)$, $\cos x\ne0$; (b) $(f\cdot f)(x)$; (c) Each pair of graphs coincides.

exercises.prompt: 一个养鱼场计划扩建。鱼群数量 $P$（以十万条为单位）随时间 $t$（年）可用 $P(t)=6(1.03)^t$ 表示。生物学家用 $F(t)=8+0.04t$ 表示可维持鱼群一年的食物量（单位）；一个单位可维持一条鱼一年。(a) 在同一坐标系画 $P,F$ 并描述趋势。(b) 每条鱼的食物按 $y=F(t)/P(t)$ 计算；另画该商，给合适窗口；哪些值不应考虑？(c) 何时每条鱼的食物量最大？(d) 食物不足以维持鱼群时，养鱼场将无法维持；这会何时发生？解释判断方法。

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $P(0)=6$，每年增长3%，为指数上升曲线；$F(0)=8$，每年线性增加0.04。图中把教材的数值模型画在一起，但纵轴单位不同：$P$ 的实际条数是 $100000P$，而原文食物是普通单位，不能把数值交点直接当供需相等。

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: 按题目指定画 $R(t)=(8+0.04t)/[6(1.03)^t]$，例如窗口 $0\le t\le60,0\le y\le1.5$。时间仅取 $t\ge0$；分母恒正，无代数零点。$R(0)=4/3$，随后递减并趋0。严格按题目单位，每条鱼实际食物量应是 $R(t)/100000$，所给 $F/P$ 少了尺度换算。

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: 在情境 $t\ge0$ 上，图示商的最大值在 $t=0$。为核对整数年份，$R(t+1)/R(t)=[1+0.04/(8+0.04t)]/1.03\le1.005/1.03<1$。连续模型也递减；最大指定数值为 $4/3$，实际食物每鱼为 $1/75000\approx0.00001333$ 单位。

steps.title: (d)
steps.body: 字面单位下，开始已有600000条鱼但只有8单位食物，只够8条，故 $t=0$ 就不够，之后每鱼食物继续下降。若另作明确假设“$F$ 也以十万单位计”，则供需数值交点由 $6(1.03)^t=8+0.04t$ 得 $t\approx11.6475$ 年（$P(11)<F(11),P(12)>F(12)$），超过该时刻不足。这个约11.65年的答案依赖教材未写出的单位修正，不能当作原文的字面结果。

exercises.answer: (a) $P$ 指数增长、$F$ 线性增长。(b) 指定商 $(8+0.04t)/[6(1.03)^t]$，$t\ge0$；实际每鱼量再除100000。(c) $t=0$ 最大。(d) 按原文单位 $t=0$ 已不足；若假设食物也以十万单位计，约11.65年后不足。

en.prompt: A fish farm plans to expand. Fish population P, in hundreds of thousands, as a function of time t in years, is modelled by $P(t)=6(1.03)^t$. Biologists use $F(t)=8+0.04t$, where F is food in units that can sustain the population for 1 year; one unit sustains one fish for 1 year. (a) Graph P and F together and describe the trends. (b) Food per fish is calculated using $y=F(t)/P(t)$. Graph it on different axes, identify a suitable window, and say whether any values should not be considered. (c) At what time is food per fish a maximum? (d) The farm is no longer viable when food cannot sustain the population. When will this occur? Explain how you determined the result.

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $P(0)=6$ and increases exponentially by 3% yearly; $F(0)=8$ and increases linearly by 0.04 yearly. The diagram plots their numerical model values together. Their printed units differ: actual fish count is $100000P$, while food is stated in plain units. A numerical intersection is therefore not a physical supply-demand equality.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: Plot the requested $R(t)=(8+0.04t)/[6(1.03)^t]$, for example in window $0\le t\le60$, $0\le y\le1.5$. Use only $t\ge0$; the denominator is always positive. $R(0)=4/3$, then it decreases toward 0. With the stated units, actual food per fish is $R(t)/100000$; the printed F/P formula omits that scale conversion.

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: For $t\ge0$, the requested quotient is maximal at $t=0$. For integer years, $R(t+1)/R(t)=[1+0.04/(8+0.04t)]/1.03\le1.005/1.03<1$; the continuous curve also decreases. Its maximum numerical value is $4/3$; with literal units the actual food per fish is $1/75000\approx0.00001333$ units.

steps.title: (d)
steps.body: With literal units there are 600000 fish but only 8 food units at $t=0$, enough for 8 fish: the farm is already short at the start, and food per fish declines thereafter. If one explicitly adds the assumption that F is also in hundreds of thousands of units, the numerical equality $6(1.03)^t=8+0.04t$ gives $t\approx11.6475$ years, with $P(11)<F(11)$ and $P(12)>F(12)$. Shortage then begins after that time. This approximately 11.65-year result depends on an unstated unit correction, not the literal source units.

en.answer: (a) Exponential P, linear F. (b) Requested ratio $(8+0.04t)/[6(1.03)^t]$, $t\ge0$; divide by 100000 for literal food per fish. (c) Maximum at $t=0$. (d) Literal units: already insufficient at 0; if food is also assumed scaled in hundred-thousands, shortage follows about 11.65 years.

exercises.prompt: 令 $f(x)=\sqrt{36-x^2},g(x)=\sin x$。(a) 在同一坐标系画 $f,g,y=(f\cdot g)(x)$。(b) 给出积的定义域和值域。(c) 画 $y=(f/g)(x)$ 并给出定义域和值域。(d) 解释 $y=(g/f)(x)$ 的定义域和值域如何不同于(c)。

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $f$ 是半径6的上半圆，过 $(-6,0),(0,6),(6,0)$；$g$ 是弧度正弦曲线。积 $H=\sqrt{36-x^2}\sin x$ 是奇函数，在 $x=-6,-\pi,0,\pi,6$ 为零；乘积位于正负半圆包络之间。解析图的第一面板同时标出三者。

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: 根式要求 $-6\le x\le6$。用图像求最大值约 $5.796879$，在 $x\approx1.525523$ 取得；奇对称给最小值为其负值。精确记 $M=\sqrt{36-\alpha^2}\sin\alpha$，其中 $\alpha\in(0,\pi/2)$ 是 $\tan\alpha=(36-\alpha^2)/\alpha$ 的唯一解，则值域 $[-M,M]$。不能把粗略包络界 $[-6,6]$ 当实际值域：$f=6$ 时 $g=0$。

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: $f/g=\sqrt{36-x^2}/\sin x$。在 $[-6,6]$ 中分母零点为 $-\pi,0,\pi$，全部排除；$\pm6$ 分母不为零，端点包括且输出0。图有三条竖直渐近线 $x=-\pi,0,\pi$。在 $[-6,-\pi)$ 上连续且从0趋 $+\infty$；在 $(\pi,6]$ 上从 $-\infty$ 连续到0，因此值域 $\mathbb{R}$。

steps.title: (d)
steps.body: $g/f=\sin x/\sqrt{36-x^2}$ 的根式在分母，故要 $36-x^2>0$，定义域 $(-6,6)$；此时 $-\pi,0,\pi$ 变为合法零点，而 $\pm6$ 被排除。整个 $(-6,6)$ 上连续，左端趋 $+\infty$（$\sin(-6)>0$），右端趋 $-\infty$（$\sin6<0$），所以值域仍为 $\mathbb{R}$。定义域改变，值域不变；渐近线改为 $x=\pm6$。

en.prompt: Let $f(x)=\sqrt{36-x^2}$ and $g(x)=\sin x$. (a) Graph f, g, and $y=(f\cdot g)(x)$ together. (b) State the domain and range of the combined product. (c) Graph $y=(f/g)(x)$ and state its domain and range. (d) Explain how the domain and range of $y=(g/f)(x)$ differ from those in (c).

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: f is the upper semicircle of radius 6 through $(-6,0),(0,6),(6,0)$; g is the sine curve in radians. Product $H=\sqrt{36-x^2}\sin x$ is odd and vanishes at $-6,-\pi,0,\pi,6$. It lies within the positive and negative semicircle envelopes. The first solution panel labels all three.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: The radical requires $-6\le x\le6$. The graph gives maximum approximately 5.796879 at $x\approx1.525523$; odd symmetry gives its negative minimum. Exactly, let $M=\sqrt{36-\alpha^2}\sin\alpha$, where $\alpha\in(0,\pi/2)$ is the unique root of $\tan\alpha=(36-\alpha^2)/\alpha$. Then $R=[-M,M]$. The envelope bound [-6,6] is not the actual range: when f=6, g=0.

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: $f/g=\sqrt{36-x^2}/\sin x$. The denominator zeros in [-6,6] are $-\pi,0,\pi$, all excluded. The endpoints $\pm6$ have nonzero sine and give 0, so they are included. There are vertical asymptotes at $-\pi,0,\pi$. On $[-6,-\pi)$ the function goes continuously from 0 to positive infinity; on $(\pi,6]$ it goes from negative infinity to 0. Hence the range is R.

steps.title: (d)
steps.body: For $g/f=\sin x/\sqrt{36-x^2}$, the denominator radical must be strictly positive, so the domain is (-6,6). Now $-\pi,0,\pi$ are valid zeros, while endpoints $\pm6$ are excluded. It is continuous throughout (-6,6), tends to positive infinity on the left because $\sin(-6)>0$, and negative infinity on the right because $\sin6<0$. Its range is still R. The domain changes, the range does not, and asymptotes move to $x=\pm6$.

exercises.prompt: 阻尼谐振子的运动可用 $d(t)=(A\sin kt)\times0.4^{ct}$ 模拟，其中 $d$ 表示随时间 $t$ 变化的距离，$A,k,c$ 为常数。(a) 若 $d=f(t)g(t)$，指出 $f,g$ 的方程并在同一坐标系画图。(b) 在同一坐标系画 $d$。

steps.body: 取 $f(t)=A\sin(kt)$、$g(t)=0.4^{ct}$。原题未给常数具体值，所以图像是参数族，而不是唯一数值图。通常阻尼情境取 $t\ge0,c>0$；$f$ 振幅 $|A|$，$k\ne0$ 时周期 $2\pi/|k|$；$g(0)=1$，从1递减趋0。附图明确选用示例 $A=k=c=1$，不是原题额外已知条件。

exercises.answer: $f=A\sin(kt)$，$g=0.4^{ct}$，$d=fg$；常数未指定，附图为明确标注的 $A=k=c=1$ 示例。

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: Choose $f(t)=A\sin(kt)$ and $g(t)=0.4^{ct}$. The source gives no numerical constants, so this is a family of graphs. For the usual damping context use $t\ge0,c>0$. f has amplitude $|A|$ and period $2\pi/|k|$ when $k\ne0$; g starts at 1 and decreases to 0. At each t multiply the ordinates of f and g. If c=0 there is no decay; c<0 gives growth; A=0 or k=0 gives the zero function. A signed sine model can be negative, so its values describe directed displacement; physical distance travelled requires a separate nonnegative quantity.

exercises.prompt: 若 $g(x)$ 为正弦型函数，$y=f(x)g(x)$ 的图像在 $f$ 与 $-f$ 之间振荡；当振幅减小时称为阻尼。(a) 给定 $f=2/(x^2+1),g=\sin(6x-1)$，说明这种情况发生。(b) 若 $f=\cos x,g=\sin(6x-1)$，是否也发生？

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: $-1\le\sin(6x-1)\le1$ 且 $f>0$，故 $-2/(x^2+1)\le y\le2/(x^2+1)$。当 $6x-1=\pi/2+2n\pi$ 取上包络，等于 $3\pi/2+2n\pi$ 取下包络。向 $x\to\pm\infty$ 两侧，包络振幅趋0；在 $x\ge0$ 随x增大而衰减，符合阻尼。所有函数定义域为实数。

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: 仍有 $|\cos x\sin(6x-1)|\le|\cos x|$，所以乘积确在 $\cos x$ 和 $-\cos x$ 两条曲线之间（两曲线会交换上下位置）。但 $|\cos x|$ 周期变化，不随x持续减小也不趋0，所以没有(a)的持续阻尼；“在包络之间”成立，“持续衰减”不成立。

exercises.answer: (a) 位于 $\pm2/(x^2+1)$ 之间，在 $x\ge0$ 呈阻尼。(b) 仍位于 $\pm\cos x$ 之间，但不是持续阻尼。

en.prompt: The graph of $y=f(x)g(x)$, where g is sinusoidal, oscillates between f and -f; reduction of amplitude is called damping. (a) Given $f(x)=2/(x^2+1)$ and $g(x)=\sin(6x-1)$, show that the scenario occurs. (b) Does it occur for $f(x)=\cos x$ and $g(x)=\sin(6x-1)$?

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: Since $-1\le\sin(6x-1)\le1$ and f>0, $-2/(x^2+1)\le y\le2/(x^2+1)$. The upper envelope is reached when $6x-1=\pi/2+2n\pi$, the lower when $6x-1=3\pi/2+2n\pi$. Envelope amplitude tends to 0 as $x\to\pm\infty$; for $x\ge0$ it decreases as x increases, demonstrating damping. All domains are R.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: We still have $|\cos x\sin(6x-1)|\le|\cos x|$, so the product lies between cos x and -cos x, even though they exchange upper and lower positions. But $|\cos x|$ varies periodically rather than continually decreasing to 0. Thus the envelope property holds, while the sustained damping in (a) does not.

en.answer: (a) Between $\pm2/(x^2+1)$, with damping for $x\ge0$. (b) Still between $\pm\cos x$, but without sustained damping.

exercises.prompt: 制造商对 $x$ 吨钢材定总价 $p$（元）：$p(x)=12x[(x+2)/(x+1)]$。使用函数的商，从代数和图像判断每吨价格是否随吨数增加而下降。

steps.title: 每吨价格 / Price per tonne
代数与图像 / Algebra and graph

en.prompt: The price p, in dollars, set by a manufacturer for x tonnes of steel is $p(x)=12x[(x+2)/(x+1)]$. Using a quotient of functions, determine algebraically and graphically whether price per tonne decreases as the number of tonnes increases.

steps.title: 每吨价格 / Price per tonne
steps.body: Divide total price by tonnage: $u(x)=p(x)/x=12(x+2)/(x+1)=12+12/(x+1)$. The original quotient excludes 0 and -1; the context further restricts to $x>0$.

steps.title: 代数与图像 / Algebra and graph
steps.body: If $0<x_1<x_2$, then their positive denominators satisfy $x_1+1<x_2+1$, so $12/(x_1+1)>12/(x_2+1)$. Thus price per tonne strictly decreases. The graph descends from limit 24 dollars/tonne as $x\to0^+$ toward horizontal asymptote 12 without reaching it. For example, $u(1)=18,u(2)=16,u(5)=14$.

en.answer: Yes. Price per tonne is $u=12+12/(x+1)$ dollars/tonne for $x>0$, strictly decreasing with range (12,24).

exercises.prompt: 一个矩形内接于半径 $r$ 的圆。若矩形长为 $2x$，把矩形面积写成两个函数的积。

steps.title: 建立直角三角形 / Form a right triangle
steps.body: 内接矩形的对角线长 $2r$，中心到一个顶点的半对角线长r。设半宽为y，则由勾股定理 $x^2+y^2=r^2$，所以 $y=\sqrt{r^2-x^2}$，全宽为 $2\sqrt{r^2-x^2}$。

steps.title: 相乘并限制 / Multiply and restrict
steps.body: 取 $f(x)=2x$、$g(x)=2\sqrt{r^2-x^2}$，则 $A=fg=4x\sqrt{r^2-x^2}$。$r>0$；非退化矩形要求 $0<x<r$。如允许退化边界，可延拓到 $0\le x\le r$，两端面积为0，但不再是正长宽矩形。

en.prompt: A rectangle is inscribed in a circle of radius r. If its length is 2 x, write its area as the product of two functions.

steps.title: 建立直角三角形 / Form a right triangle
steps.body: The rectangle diagonal is 2 r, so the center-to-vertex half-diagonal is r. If half-width is y, Pythagoras gives $x^2+y^2=r^2$, hence $y=\sqrt{r^2-x^2}$ and full width $2\sqrt{r^2-x^2}$.

steps.title: 相乘并限制 / Multiply and restrict
steps.body: Choose $f(x)=2x$ and $g(x)=2\sqrt{r^2-x^2}$. Then $A=fg=4x\sqrt{r^2-x^2}$, with r>0 and $0<x<r$ for a nondegenerate rectangle. A degenerate extension to $0\le x\le r$ has area 0 at both endpoints.

exercises.prompt: 函数的积是否满足交换律？选择函数 $f,g$，解释是否 $f(x)g(x)=g(x)f(x)$。

steps.title: 共同定义域上的交换律 / Commutativity on the common domain
steps.body: 是。在 $D_f\cap D_g$ 内，函数值都是实数，实数乘法满足交换律。例取 $f=x+1,g=x^2$：$f g=(x+1)x^2=x^3+x^2=x^2(x+1)=g f$，两者定义域同为实数。即使原函数有限制，两积仍有同一个共同定义域。

exercises.answer: 是，$(f\cdot g)(x)=(g\cdot f)(x)$，定义域都为 $D_f\cap D_g$。

en.prompt: Is the product of functions commutative? Choose functions f and g to explain whether $f(x)g(x)=g(x)f(x)$.

steps.title: 共同定义域上的交换律 / Commutativity on the common domain
steps.body: Yes. On $D_f\cap D_g$, both outputs are real numbers, so real multiplication is commutative. For $f=x+1,g=x^2$, $fg=(x+1)x^2=x^3+x^2=x^2(x+1)=gf$, with domain R. Restricted original domains still give the same common domain for either product order.

en.answer: Yes: $(f\cdot g)(x)=(g\cdot f)(x)$ on the same domain $D_f\cap D_g$.

exercises.prompt: 比较函数乘积与商的定义域性质的相同点和不同点。

steps.title: 共同部分 / Common requirement
steps.body: 两者都只使用两个原函数同时有定义的点：积的定义域 $D_{fg}=D_f\cap D_g$。例如 $f=\sqrt{x-1},g=x-2$，共同定义域为 $x\ge1$。

steps.title: 商的额外条件 / Additional quotient condition
steps.body: 商 $f/g$ 还要求 $g\ne0$，故 $D_{f/g}=\{x\in D_f\cap D_g:g(x)\ne0\}$。上例积允许 $x=2$ 且值0，而商必须排除2。约分不恢复被删去点；反向商 $g/f$ 会改为排除 $f$ 的零点，本例为1。

exercises.answer: 积取共同定义域；商在共同定义域中再删去分母函数零点。

en.prompt: Compare and contrast the properties of the domains of products and quotients of functions.

steps.title: 共同部分 / Common requirement
steps.body: Both require the original functions to be defined together. Thus $D_{fg}=D_f\cap D_g$. For $f=\sqrt{x-1},g=x-2$, the common domain is $x\ge1$.

steps.title: 商的额外条件 / Additional quotient condition
steps.body: A quotient f/g also requires $g\ne0$, so $D_{f/g}=\{x\in D_f\cap D_g:g(x)\ne0\}$. In the example the product allows x=2 and equals 0 there, whereas f/g excludes 2. Cancellation never restores an excluded point. Reversing the quotient excludes zeros of f instead, here 1.

en.answer: A product uses the common domain; a quotient additionally removes zeros of its denominator function.

exercises.prompt: 一个正方形底盒子的体积 $V$（立方厘米）为 $V(x)=4x^3+4x^2-39x+36$。(a) 若底边长为 $2x-3$，用合成函数表示底面积 $A(x)$。(b) 画 $A$ 并说明情境中的定义域和值域。(c) 求 $h(x)=V(x)/A(x)$，并说明意义。(d) 画 $h$，说明情境中的定义域和值域。

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: 底边必须为正：$2x-3>0$，所以 $x>\frac32$。只画抛物线 $A=(2x-3)^2$ 顶点右侧，并在 $(\frac32,0)$ 留空心点；面积可为任意正数，故 $D=(\frac32,\infty),R=(0,\infty)$。

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: 分解体积：$V=(x+4)(2x-3)^2$，乘回为 $4x^3+4x^2-39x+36$。于是 $h=V/A=x+4$，约分后仍不能取 $x=\frac32$。体积除以底面积得到盒子高度，单位厘米；实际域上高度始终正。

steps.title: (d)
steps.body: 在情境定义域 $x>\frac32$ 画射线 $h=x+4$，起点 $(\frac32,\frac{11}2)$ 不包括。因此 $D_h=(\frac32,\infty)$，$R_h=(\frac{11}2,\infty)$ 厘米；不能加入负边长的另一个代数分支。

en.prompt: The volume V, in cubic centimetres, of a square-based box is $V(x)=4x^3+4x^2-39x+36$. (a) Write a combined function for base area A(x) if the base side length is 2 x-3. (b) Graph A and state its domain and range in this context. (c) Determine $h(x)=V(x)/A(x)$ and explain what it represents. (d) Graph h and state its contextual domain and range.

steps.title: (a)
steps.body: The square area is side times side: $A=(2x-3)(2x-3)=(2x-3)^2=4x^2-12x+9$ square centimetres.

steps.title: (b)
steps.body: The base side must be positive: $2x-3>0$, hence $x>\frac32$. Plot only the right branch of $A=(2x-3)^2$, with an open endpoint $(\frac32,0)$. Every positive area is possible, so $D=(\frac32,\infty)$, $R=(0,\infty)$.

steps.title: (c)
steps.body: Factor $V=(x+4)(2x-3)^2$; multiplying returns $4x^3+4x^2-39x+36$. Thus $h=V/A=x+4$, retaining the exclusion $x=\frac32$. Volume divided by base area is the box height in centimetres, which is positive throughout the contextual domain.

steps.title: (d)
steps.body: On the contextual domain $x>\frac32$, draw the ray $h=x+4$ with excluded starting point $(\frac32,\frac{11}2)$. Thus $D_h=(\frac32,\infty)$ and $R_h=(\frac{11}2,\infty)$ centimetres. The algebraic branch with negative base-side lengths is not physical.
